summary: Verified 3 bug fixes in 9x_security (updater 404 + baked DEFAULT_REPO, font-size increases, non-blocking disconnect). All 14 tests in test_engine.py pass. Live GitHub API calls confirm 404 handling for repo with no releases (torvalds/linux) and normal tag retrieval for repo with releases (microsoft/terminal). CI-bake sed simulation replaces DEFAULT_REPO correctly and module still imports. Code inspection of main.py confirms: no gh_repo QLineEdit remains, _check_update uses updater.DEFAULT_REPO with friendly Hindi messages for empty repo / no release / network error; VideoThread.request_stop is non-blocking (only sets _running=False); toggle_connect disconnects all 3 signals, nulls self.thread, calls request_stop (no wait), and resets Connect button/status/video label instantly; _open is an instance method checking self._running in transport loop + frame-wait loop and returns None on abort; run() handles cap is None and reconnect path returns when _open gives None. Font sizes verified: QWidget 15px, QPushButton padding 10px 16px, header 26px, login title 28px, stat value 36px, table header font-weight:600. workflow YAML valid; version step also seds DEFAULT_REPO with $GITHUB_REPOSITORY.
critical_code_review_comments: test_engine.py has 14 test functions total (not 15 as the request stated) — count discrepancy is only in the request text; the new test_updater_404_and_default_repo IS present and passes.
Legacy stop() with wait(3000) is still defined on VideoThread; not called anywhere now but leaving it is fine as long as toggle_connect uses request_stop() (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PyQt5 not installable in this Linux container - main.py verified by py_compile + grep-based code inspection only. pytest command: cd /app/9x_security && python -m pytest test_engine.py -v. Live GitHub check works from container without auth (may rate-limit; treat as skip).
rca of the issue: All 3 reported bugs verified as fixed in code. (1) 404 -> friendly message via check_latest returning ('', None, '') on HTTPError 404; DEFAULT_REPO baked at CI. (2) Fonts uniformly enlarged. (3) Disconnect now instant: signals disconnected first, non-blocking request_stop, UI reset synchronously - thread's _open loops honor self._running and return None so run() exits cleanly without hanging.
